answer: Give every identity a place as a vertex in a shared work graph, and let trust flow only through completed jobs that independent peers verified. A new identity starts hollow: no history, no credit, however loudly it claims skill. Reputation accrues glacier-slow, one verified job at a time, and bursts of fresh vertices vouching for each other are discounted as a clique. A sybil farmer must therefore buy a genuine work history for every fake, paying real compute and real time per identity, which turns mass fakery from cheap duplication into a slow, expensive grind.
